_comment: Filter lists AdGuard Home should have enabled, applied by adguard/apply-filters.py.
This file is the source of truth; the running instance is reconciled to it.
Chosen for ONE job above all: killing the advertising SDKs embedded in Android
games running in the Google Play Games crosvm VM. The generic 'AdGuard DNS filter'
alone left roughly 20% of in-game ads getting through.
Deliberately NOT included: HaGeZi Pro++/Ultimate and 1Hosts Xtra. They block more,
but they over-block, and a game that will not start is a worse outcome than an ad -
it turns the parent against the whole system.

filters.name: AdGuard DNS filter
filters.why: Baseline: AdGuard Base + Social + Tracking + Mobile Ads + EasyList/EasyPrivacy.

filters.name: AWAvenue Ads Rule
filters.why: THE list for this problem. Targets advertising SDKs inside Android apps specifically, which is exactly what the games embed.

filters.name: AdAway Default Blocklist
filters.why: Android hosts list. Was already present in AdGuard but shipped DISABLED, which is easy to miss.

filters.name: Dandelion Sprout's Game Console Adblock List
filters.why: Ad endpoints specific to games rather than the web.

filters.name: HaGeZi's Pro Blocklist
filters.why: Broad ads/tracking/telemetry. 'Pro', not Pro++ or Ultimate: those over-block and start breaking the games themselves.

filters.name: Peter Lowe's Blocklist
filters.why: Small, old, very low false-positive rate. Cheap insurance.

filters.name: HaGeZi's Encrypted DNS/VPN/TOR/Proxy Bypass
filters.why: Closes the hole that made the DNS layer decorative in the first place - Avast Secure DNS and Opera GX's VPN both resolved around it. Blocks known DoH/VPN/proxy endpoints, so a browser that ships its own resolver cannot reach it.

filters.name: HaGeZi's Threat Intelligence Feeds
filters.why: Malware, phishing, scam. Child protection rather than ad blocking, and in-game ads are a common delivery route for exactly this.

known_false_positives.impact: Firebase app-instance registration. Games have worked with it blocked, so it is left alone - but whitelist it here first if a game starts failing to launch or sign in.
